description: The autonomy.uses happy path (S56 T6, AL10): the use-log rows with begun/outcome PAIRED in. A begun row carries the outcome of the completed/failed row that closed it; a begun row the process stopped before closing reports the fixed unknown sentence rather than a silent missing outcome (the receipt-first shape made readable). A completed/failed row is an outcome, not a use — its outcome is null on the wire. The caller's limit applies as the newest N, ascending; the full filtered set is paired before the limit, so a cut cannot orphan a begun from its outcome.
